recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a human identifies a concrete current publication defect where the ElementDefinition page no longer exposes its generated UML or JSON template.
issue_request: FHIR-5371 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot comment asking to add missing ElementDefinition UML diagram and JSON template representations from the infrastructure/base documentation area.
initial_application: No source-changing commit explicitly naming FHIR-5371 was identified during this bounded reconciliation. The Jira comments themselves say the work was done already, and the current page is generated from the active datatype source rather than from static hand-written representation prose.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active in the current build: source/fhir.ini lists it as a datatype, maps elementdefinition to its own type page, marks it normative, and assigns the eld abbreviation. source/hierarchy.xml places elementdefinition.html under DataTypes, source/elementdefinition.html emits the generated ElementDefinition datatype block, and build.fhir.org currently shows Structure, UML, XML, JSON, Turtle, Version Diff, and All tabs with explicit UML Diagram, XML Template, and JSON Template sections. A later existing reconciliation for FHIR-23042 audited ElementDefinition UML readability separately and treated FHIR-5371 as background.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because the requested current-spec representations are already generated from active source.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue audited ElementDefinition UML diagram readability and confirmed the active source/rendering pipeline already carries diagram-driving ElementDefinition data. It is already represented on the combined branch and was not decided again.
